# S1. Comparison with the baseline ARIMA model

Figure S1. Figure 2 with the baseline ARIMA model included: hospital admissions forecasts overlaid with the evaluation data and WIS by horizon, for the same example location-forecast dates.

Figure S3. WIS by model stratified by location and by forecast date, broken down by underprediction, overprediction and dispersion, including the baseline ARIMA model, with national hospital admissions over time.

# S2. Epidemic phase

The epidemic phase of each forecast was defined from the change in the final evaluation data over the 28-day forecast period, for hospital admissions by location and for wastewater by site (see Methods).

Figure S4. Epidemic phase by forecast date for each location. Top panel: hospital admissions (7-day rolling sum) from the final evaluation dataset, with each forecast date to 7 days later shaded by the hospital admissions phase over the following 28 days. Bottom panels: log wastewater concentrations at each site, shaded by that site's phase.
